/*
 * Las ocho superficies que pide la auditoría visual, a 390 px, con el código de
 * esta rama y los datos REALES de producción. Sólo lee: no confirma ningún
 * pedido. La «confirmación» se captura en modo demostración, que es la única
 * forma honesta de mostrarla sin crear una venta real.
 */
import { chromium } from '@playwright/test';
import { mkdirSync } from 'node:fs';

const BASE = process.env.TABA_BASE || 'http://127.0.0.1:4599';
const OUT = process.env.TABA_OUT || '.local/qa/evidencia';
mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });

const CONFIG = `globalThis.__LA_TABA_RUNTIME_CONFIG__ = {
  mode: 'production',
  repository: { provider: 'supabase', deploymentEnvironment: 'production',
    supabaseUrl: 'https://wwcpogltfgzgkrlilbcd.supabase.co',
[EXCLUIDO: credencial/configuración; recrear localmente.]
    businessId: '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001', pollMs: 5000 } };`;

const nav = await chromium.launch();
const ctx = await nav.newContext({
  viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 }, hasTouch: true, isMobile: true,
  deviceScaleFactor: 2, locale: 'es-AR',
});
await ctx.route(`${BASE}/runtime-config.js`, (r) => r.fulfill({ status: 200, contentType: 'application/javascript', body: CONFIG }));
const page = await ctx.newPage();
const errores = [];
page.on('pageerror', (e) => errores.push(`pageerror: ${e.message.slice(0, 110)}`));
page.on('console', (m) => { if (m.type() === 'error') errores.push(`console: ${m.text().slice(0, 110)}`); });

const paso = async (nombre, accion) => {
  await accion();
  await page.waitForTimeout(2000);
  await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUT}/${nombre}.png` });
  console.log(`  ${nombre}`);
};

await page.goto(`${BASE}/#home`, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
await page.locator('html[data-taba-startup="ready"]').waitFor({ state: 'attached', timeout: 90_000 });
await page.waitForTimeout(3000);

console.log('capturado:');
await paso('01-home', async () => {});
await paso('02-recomendados', async () => {
  await page.evaluate(() => {
    const t = [...document.querySelectorAll('h2')].find((h) => /Recomendados/i.test(h.textContent || ''));
    t?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' });
  });
});
await paso('03-categoria', async () => { await page.evaluate(() => { window.location.hash = '#catalog'; }); });
await paso('04-detalle', async () => {
  const pack = page.locator('.product-card:has-text("Pack x12")').first();
  const objetivo = (await pack.count()) ? pack.locator('[data-product-detail]').first() : page.locator('[data-product-detail] >> visible=true').first();
  await objetivo.click();
});
await paso('05-carrito', async () => {
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
  await page.waitForTimeout(600);
  await page.locator('[data-add-product] >> visible=true').first().click();
  await page.waitForTimeout(800);
  await page.locator('[data-open-cart] >> visible=true').first().click();
});
await paso('06-checkout', async () => {
  await page.evaluate(() => { document.querySelector('[data-checkout-form]')?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); });
});
await paso('07-seguimiento', async () => { await page.evaluate(() => { window.location.hash = '#tracking'; }); });

console.log(`\nerrores: ${JSON.stringify([...new Set(errores)].slice(0, 5))}`);
await nav.close();
